_comment: Offline models the SPACEMAP assistant can install and run.
This file ships with the package and is read-only at runtime.
To add a model, or to correct an entry, use Tab 0 > AI Assistant > Model library,
or edit the user catalog at <config dir>/model_catalog.json, which overrides
entries here by 'id'. Repository names and revisions change over time; verify
an entry on huggingface.co before reporting a download problem.
'backend' is 'transformers' for a model directory or 'gguf' for a single

models.name: Gemma 4 12B Instruct
models.notes: Reference model for SPACEMAP. Handles text and image questions, so it can comment on registration and segmentation previews. Needs a 28 GB GPU for comfortable use; runs on CPU but slowly. Accepting the model terms on Hugging Face may be required before download.

models.name: Qwen3 4B Instruct (Q4_K_M)
models.notes: Small quantized model for machines with no GPU. Text only, so it cannot look at images, but it answers pipeline questions and drafts parameters on a laptop. Recommended starting point.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
models.notes: Text-only alternative with a mid-size GPU footprint. Access must be requested on Hugging Face and approved before the download will work.
